Póvoa de Varzim · Vila do Conde · Metro do Porto
Stay in Póvoa de Varzim or Vila do Conde. Day-trip Porto by metro.

Both towns sit on the Atlantic and on Metro do Porto’s red line. You get a beach evening and, on most dates, a cheaper room than Ribeira. You still do São Bento, the Gaia cellars and the river in a normal city day.
Who should sleep on the coast
Couples or families who want sea air after Porto’s hills.
Anyone comparing Ribeira hotel prices and flinching.
Stay in central Porto instead if you want bars until 3am every night.
Metro do Porto: airport, coast, city
Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport → coast:
metro toward Póvoa de Varzim. Pre-book a transfer only if you land late with heavy bags.
Póvoa / Vila do Conde → Porto:
red line. Get off around Trindade, Bolhão or São Bento and walk.
Last trains:
not 24h. Check before a late dinner in town.

How long is the metro from Póvoa de Varzim to Porto?
About 30–40 minutes on Metro do Porto’s red line into central Porto. Last trains are not 24 hours.
Is it cheaper to stay in Póvoa de Varzim than in Ribeira?
On many dates waterfront rooms in Póvoa and Vila do Conde cost less than equivalent Ribeira hotels. You trade about 35 minutes each way.
